import struct, zlib, pathlib

def chunk(t, d):
    return struct.pack('>I', len(d)) + t + d + struct.pack('>I', zlib.crc32(t+d)&0xffffffff)

sig=b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'
ihdr=chunk(b'IHDR', struct.pack('>IIBBBBB',1,1,8,6,0,0,0))
# Put a valid IDAT then a critical chunk after it to trigger ECHUNK_POS in read_chunks_after_idat.
idat=chunk(b'IDAT', zlib.compress(b'\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00'))
# critical chunk after IDAT
bad=chunk(b'IHDR', struct.pack('>IIBBBBB',1,1,8,6,0,0,0))
poc=sig+ihdr+idat+bad+chunk(b'IEND', b'')
pathlib.Path('crit_after_idat.png').write_bytes(poc)
print(len(poc))
